item.title: BMS sees win and loss with Sotyktu in two pivotal SLE trials
item.dc:creator: Abigail Beaney
item.description:
BMS said the second Phase III SLE trial of Sotyktu failed due to “high placebo response”.

The post BMS sees win and loss with Sotyktu in two pivotal SLE trials appeared first on Clinical Trials Arena.

item.title: Applied Biologics treats first patient in Phase III diabetic foot ulcer study
item.dc:creator: Salong Debbarma
item.description:
Applied Biologics has treated the first patient in a Phase III trial assessing BIOxHEAL for chronic, nonhealing diabetic foot ulcers.

The post Applied Biologics treats first patient in Phase III diabetic foot ulcer study appeared first on Clinical Trials Arena.

item.title: GSK’s Exdensur meets primary endpoint in Phase III EGPA trial
item.dc:creator: Salong Debbarma
item.description:
GSK’s Exdensur has met the primary endpoint in the Phase III OCEAN study when compared with mepolizumab in patients with EGPA.

The post GSK’s Exdensur meets primary endpoint in Phase III EGPA trial appeared first on Clinical Trials Arena.

item.title: Desentum’s Phase II birch allergy trial meets primary endpoint
item.dc:creator: Abigail Beaney
item.description:
In the Phase II trial, Desentum’s therapy reduced birch allergy symptoms after just 10 weeks, with benefit continuing through 25 weeks.

The post Desentum’s Phase II birch allergy trial meets primary endpoint appeared first on Clinical Trials Arena.

item.title: WHO launches knowledge portal for inclusion of pregnant women in trials
item.dc:creator: Abigail Beaney
item.description:
Pregnant and lactating women are commonly underrepresented in clincial trials, making it challenging for physicians to prescribe drugs safely.

The post WHO launches knowledge portal for inclusion of pregnant women in trials appeared first on Clinical Trials Arena.
